info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Piezoelectric API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: piezo_modulus_max
params.description: Maximum value for the piezoelectric modulus in C/m².

params.name: piezo_modulus_min
params.description: Minimum value for the piezoelectric modulus in C/m².

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from PiezoelectricDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `material_id` `deprecated` `deprecation_reasons` `last_updated` `origins` `warnings` `structure` `property_name` `total` `ionic` `electronic` `e_ij_max` `max_direction` `strain_for_max`
